notes.title: New version Update - New gameplay added
notes.content:
New gameplay: Exploration mode
In this mode, you need to form your own team and gradually strengthen your team members as you explore this post-apocalyptic world and fight various monsters.
During the exploration, you will harvest weapons and equipment, which are all sharp tools to help you finish the level!

Weapons: Weapons have multiple attribute terms, each of which can be superimposed. And as the weapon level increases, the basic attack power will also increase, and the quality of the weapon will also affect the attack power bonus. Meanwhile! The character level also affects the attack bonus, the higher the character level, the higher the bonus will be.

Equipment: There are up to 33 kinds of equipment, each equipment has its own effects, quality will affect the bonus of these effects, when the quality is [orange], the equipment will appear high-quality exclusive special effects. It is worth noting that there will be a connection between equipment and equipment, and each other can produce a 1+1 greater than 2 effect.

There is also a link between weapon attribute entries and equipment effects, which can be used to create their own features for characters, or even to create their own features for entire teams.

Characters are generally divided into two categories, namely firearms and non-firearms, each character's attributes and characteristics are different, they also have their own exclusive skills, at the same time, there are a maximum of 9 characters, need to consider which role to recruit first.
Of course, they will also be stored in the character backpack, and they can be replaced at any time when they are needed.

As the level progresses, the monsters change and strengthen with the map, but not only that, as you encounter the BOSS, the BOSS will increase over time.

For more fun in the new mode, please also dear players to enter the game to experience it, I wish you a happy game.

notes.title: 12/2 update content
notes.content:
[b]New characters appear[/b]
Avril Bond(七月)
Initial attributes: Atk 15,Spd 155,Crt 70
Skill:
[Suppression shot]Shoot 10 bullets continuously, each bullet is a part of the normal attack damage
[Multiple shot]Empty the magazine and fire 30 bullets continuously, causing a lot of damage

Hong Bond(Zi)
Initial attributes: Atk 28,Spd 145,Crt 110
Skill:
[Massacre]Shoot 3 times in a row, the range and damage gradually increase
[Annihilation]Shooting forward causes huge damage in a wide area

New
1. New difficulties and hell difficulties are added, and you can get some resource support when opening them.
2. Added the "Strafing Support" skill, which can be used on difficulty and hell difficulties.

repair

2. Fixed the problem of incorrect health value when upgrading "Research Center - Stronger Defense"
3. Fixed the issue where the characters would not attack after the combined skills of Zi and Luo Li were released.

notes.title: 11/28 update content: Fixed the problem of being stuck and unable to play the ga
notes.content:
Function
1. Added a new archive button, next to "Settings", click to save manually
2. When starting a new game, a prompt to overwrite the archive will pop up.
3. After killing the final BOSS, relevant data will be stored and used for subsequent new content.

repair
1. Fixed the issue where the game may get stuck when "Character - Luo Li" triggers random shooting skills.
2. There is a problem that character skills may no longer be released when challenging again.
3. Fixed the problem that the double speed sometimes disappears when switching from "Night" to "Morning"
4. Fixed the problem of abnormal UI position when loading archives
5. Fixed the issue where the character cannot be dragged after replacing the backpack character on the field.
6. Fixed the issue where the bonded character is no longer on the field, but the combo will still be released.
7. Fixed the issue where the HP of the roadblock is restored to full when upgrading the roadblock in the "Research Center"

9. Fixed the problem that when selecting a character, when clicking on a character that has not exited, the introduction will not switch, and the skill icon will still disappear when switching back to other characters.
10.Fixed the problem that the BOSS was not generated in the 100th level and caused the level to be abnormal.

optimization

PS: If there has been an archive before, an error will appear in the UI after loading the archive. It will return to normal after starting a new game.

notes.title: Updated content on November 23
notes.content:
Function:
1. Added "Survival Manual" guidance. Players who enter the game for the first time will open it first to view the game tutorial.
2. Add the "one-click upgrade" function. Moving to the button will display how many resources are currently required to upgrade all characters. Priority will be given to upgrading the first character obtained.
3. When the health value of the roadblock is 0 (failed to hold on), a prompt box will pop up, and you can choose to return to the first 5 levels of the current level (for example: current level 50, return to level 45), and the character level and resources reserve.
